about: Breeder questions for eval/harness.py. Each names the KIND of answer it expects; the harness computes the answer by code from the cache copy it runs on, so this file holds no answers. The study and trait catalogs answer q01-q12; q13-q14 need the cached plot records of study 05DISE178HFLNO7 (SweetPotatoBase study 4501, variable 76736): on sweetpotatobase.org the app reads measurements from the plot records, which keep the values recorded as 0. CassavaBase\part2\cache\live holds that study's /observations page but, on 2026-10-22, not its plot records; until they are added, q13-q14 are skipped.
